remaining_cautions.evidence_context: Primary Figure 1/prose supports toxicity trends but not exact tabulated DBAASP percentages; exact database toxicity values remain source_conflict rather than source_verified.
Primary Table 1 captures lipid tags, D-residues, ornithine acylation, and amidation; merged DBAASP sequence strings use compact normalized forms and are not smoothed over.
OA package supplement SM9825 was text-indexed and contains synthesis, HRMS, and HPLC chemistry data only; no supplementary MIC/toxicity tables were found locally.
